gisborne_stand_down_cases.name: School stand-downs
gisborne_stand_down_cases.caveat: Published cases at schools in Gisborne District. Case counts describe school decisions and may count a student more than once.

gisborne_suspension_cases.name: School suspensions
gisborne_suspension_cases.caveat: Published cases at schools in Gisborne District. Case counts describe school decisions and may count a student more than once.

gisborne_exclusion_cases.name: School exclusions
gisborne_exclusion_cases.caveat: Published cases at schools in Gisborne District. Exclusion is the formal removal of a student under 16.

gisborne_expulsion_cases.name: School expulsions
gisborne_expulsion_cases.caveat: Published cases at schools in Gisborne District. Expulsion is the formal removal of a student aged 16 or over.

gisborne_council_operating_income.name: Council operating income
gisborne_council_operating_income.caveat: Core non-trading activities of Gisborne District Council, year ended June, in current New Zealand dollars.

gisborne_council_operating_expenditure.name: Council operating expenditure
gisborne_council_operating_expenditure.caveat: Core non-trading activities of Gisborne District Council, year ended June, in current New Zealand dollars.

river_ecoli_median.name: Median E. coli at monitored river sites
river_ecoli_median.caveat: Measured site medians per 100 mL over 2020–2024. This monitoring-period snapshot differs from current conditions. See the publisher for methods.

gisborne_live_births.name: Registered live births
gisborne_live_births.caveat: Gisborne Region by usual residence of the mother, for the December year. Stats NZ applies random rounding.

gisborne_registered_deaths.name: Registered deaths
gisborne_registered_deaths.caveat: Gisborne Region by usual residence of the deceased, for the December year. Stats NZ applies random rounding.

gisborne_july_school_roll.name: July school roll
gisborne_july_school_roll.caveat: Published headcount as at 1 July for schools located in Gisborne District.

gisborne_prior_ece_participation.name: Early learning participation before starting school
gisborne_prior_ece_participation.caveat: Share of children starting school in Gisborne District who regularly attended early learning in the preceding six months. Quarterly points cover the year ended that quarter. Children with unknown attendance are excluded.

gisborne_population_projection_low.name: Population projection · low
gisborne_population_projection_low.caveat: Stats NZ 2023-base low scenario for Gisborne Region at 30 June. Values are projections under stated assumptions.

gisborne_population_projection_medium.name: Population projection · medium
gisborne_population_projection_medium.caveat: Stats NZ 2023-base medium scenario for Gisborne Region at 30 June. Values are projections under stated assumptions.

gisborne_population_projection_high.name: Population projection · high
gisborne_population_projection_high.caveat: Stats NZ 2023-base high scenario for Gisborne Region at 30 June. Values are projections under stated assumptions.

gisborne_residential_electricity.name: Average residential electricity consumption
gisborne_residential_electricity.caveat: Average kilowatt-hours drawn from the grid per residential connection in Gisborne Region. Self-consumed generation and weather adjustments are excluded.

gisborne_filled_jobs.name: Filled jobs
gisborne_filled_jobs.caveat: Actual monthly filled jobs in Gisborne Region from Stats NZ employment indicators. Jobs are counted rather than individual people. Recent months may be revised.

gisborne_new_dwellings_consented.name: New dwellings consented
gisborne_new_dwellings_consented.caveat: Monthly counts for Gisborne District. A consent is an approval and does not record a completed dwelling.

gisborne_building_consent_value.name: Value of building consents
gisborne_building_consent_value.caveat: New and altered construction combined for Gisborne District, at current prices in New Zealand dollars.

gisborne_guest_nights.name: Commercial accommodation guest nights
gisborne_guest_nights.caveat: Gisborne Region estimates cover commercial accommodation with at least six stay units. Monthly figures are estimates and may be revised.

gisborne_active_accommodation.name: Active commercial accommodation establishments
gisborne_active_accommodation.caveat: Gisborne Region estimates cover commercial accommodation with at least six stay units.

gisborne_census_families.name: Families in occupied private dwellings
gisborne_census_families.caveat: Published census counts for Gisborne Region. Stats NZ applies random rounding. Census methods changed across the 2013, 2018 and 2023 releases.

gisborne_census_households.name: Households in occupied private dwellings
gisborne_census_households.caveat: Published census counts for Gisborne Region. Stats NZ applies random rounding. Census methods changed across the 2013, 2018 and 2023 releases.

gisborne_nominal_gdp.name: Regional GDP at current prices (NZ$ million)
gisborne_nominal_gdp.caveat: Production measure, in millions of New Zealand dollars, for the year ended March. Changes include price changes.

gisborne_nominal_gdp_per_person.name: Regional GDP per person at current prices
gisborne_nominal_gdp_per_person.caveat: New Zealand dollars per person for the year ended March. Regional production per person differs from household income.

hud_house_price_to_income.name: Median house price to median household income
hud_house_price_to_income.caveat: The published Local Housing Statistics time series for Gisborne District.

hud_deposit_affordability.name: Deposit affordability index
hud_deposit_affordability.caveat: The HUD index compares house sale prices with median disposable household income over time.

hud_mortgage_affordability.name: Mortgage affordability index
hud_mortgage_affordability.caveat: The HUD index compares mortgage servicing costs with median disposable household income over time.

hud_rent_affordability.name: Rent affordability index
hud_rent_affordability.caveat: The HUD index compares rent prices on new bonds with median disposable household income over time.

school_leavers_level_2.name: School leavers with NCEA Level 2 or above
school_leavers_level_2.caveat: Percentage of school leavers with NCEA Level 2 or equivalent or above. Geography refers to the school’s location.

gisborne_mayoral_turnout.name: Gisborne mayoral turnout
gisborne_mayoral_turnout.caveat: Share of enrolled electors voting in the contested Gisborne District Council mayoral election. The table shows verified election snapshots.

gisborne_te_reo_speakers.name: People who can speak te reo Māori
gisborne_te_reo_speakers.caveat: The 2023 Census figure is for Gisborne Region. The question asks whether people can have a conversation about everyday things in te reo Māori.

regional_ghg_emissions.name: Gross greenhouse gas emissions
regional_ghg_emissions.caveat: Gisborne Region industry and household emissions, in kilotonnes of CO₂ equivalent. Uses the production approach and the residence principle. Excludes consumption-based emissions. Earlier years can be revised.

regular_school_attendance.name: Students attending school regularly
regular_school_attendance.caveat: Percentage of students in Gisborne Region state and state-integrated schools who attended more than 90% of the term. COVID-19 affected comparability in 2020 and 2021. Reporting changed from Term 1 2025. CSV dates are the corresponding calendar-quarter boundaries for indexing by term.

pop_estimate.name: Estimated resident population
pop_estimate.caveat: Estimated at 30 June. Rebased after each census (2023 rebase).

pop_median_age.name: Median age
pop_median_age.caveat: Half the population is older and half younger. Estimated at 30 June.

bds_geographic_units.name: Business locations (geographic units)
bds_geographic_units.caveat: Business locations (geographic units) with economic activity, at February each year. Counts randomly rounded.

bds_employee_count.name: Employees in business locations
bds_employee_count.caveat: Employee count at February. Counts randomly rounded.

msd_main_benefits_total.name: Working-age people on a main benefit
msd_main_benefits_total.caveat: Working-age (18–64) recipients at the end of each quarter. Counts randomly rounded to base 3.

msd_jobseeker.name: Jobseeker Support recipients
msd_jobseeker.caveat: Best Tairāwhiti-only labour-market signal: the HLFS unemployment rate is only published for Gisborne/Hawke's Bay combined.

msd_supported_living.name: Supported Living Payment recipients
msd_supported_living.caveat: Includes carers and people with a health condition or disability; a rise is not necessarily negative.

rent_geomean.name: Mean weekly rent, new bonds (geometric mean)
rent_geomean.caveat: Private-landlord bonds lodged in the month. Fixed random rounding; months with fewer than 5 bonds suppressed.

hud_register_applicants.name: Social housing register applicants
hud_register_applicants.caveat: Housing Register plus Transfer Register, at month end.

hud_social_housing_chp.name: Social housing places – community housing providers

hud_eh_grants.name: Emergency housing grants approved
hud_eh_grants.caveat: Emergency Housing Special Needs Grants. Monthly counts are small and volatile.

imms_6m.name: Children fully immunised at 6 months
imms_6m.caveat: Rolling 12-month coverage by district of residence. National target is 95%.

imms_24m.name: Children fully immunised at 24 months
imms_24m.caveat: Rolling 12-month coverage by district of residence. Health target: 95% by 24 months.

cas_dsi.name: Road deaths and serious injuries
cas_dsi.caveat: Calendar year. CAS is live: recent years may still change. Current year is year-to-date.

cas_deaths.name: Road deaths
cas_deaths.caveat: Small annual numbers; read multi-year trends, not single years.
